description: Send an iMessage (blue bubble) from the brand's own Sendblue line or LoopMessage sender: text, a photo or file (media: a Library id, attachment://N or an https link; Sendblue takes one, LoopMessage up to 10) and an optional screen effect. to is a phone number (+14155550123) or an Apple Account email. Sendblue sends it as an SMS by itself when the person has no iMessage. Replies arrive in the Inbox. The account and its terms are the customer's own: Sendblue's terms ban bulk and unsolicited marketing, LoopMessage's ban spam and outbound-only sending. Free in Hermoso; the provider bills its plan. Needs the brand's own Sendblue or LoopMessage account connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).

from.description: Sendblue: one of the brand's lines (+E.164); LoopMessage: the sender name. Default: the only line, or the saved sender

media.description: Library ids, attachment://N or https links

replyTo.description: the id of a message to reply to inline

to.description: phone number (E.164) or Apple Account email

name: send_imessage
title: Send an iMessage
